resolvedFindings.title: Revoked original private alias previously blocked all later memory outcomes.

resolvedFindings.title: New work-outcome sources previously lacked the owner erasure path.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The existing current owner source lookup remains mandatory. Non-exchange documents are admitted for erasure only when owns(document) finds a queued durable work marker with exact document ID, content hash and complete scoped provenance hash. Task erasure uses source_message_id=None, so the original question and reply are preserved. Projection markers remain after document/outbox erasure.
resolvedFindings.verification: Read exact final guard and PostgreSQL regression: actual scoped owner source lookup, forged-content rejection, owner command with fake semantic transport, actual durable outbox redaction, preserved original reply, and no projection after restart. Coordinator reports final PG test passed.

resolvedFindings.title: Enqueue-before-marker recovery must respect an already erased outcome.
resolvedFindings.resolution: _recorded reads the existing outbox event under the distinct conversation/runtime scope. Apart from the separately assigned budget retention deadline, queued source data must exactly match. Erased content remains absent and becomes an erased projection skip marker. Recovery never calls submit again, preventing resurrection or a permanently blocking queue head.
resolvedFindings.verification: Read model-free existing-erasure unit check including rejection of a different principal, plus run_once reconciliation and persistent marker/query composition. No claim of a live process-kill experiment or real provider retention.

blockers.title: New work-outcome sources cannot use the existing owner erasure command.
blockers.finding: The producer creates work-outcome:<digest>, while dashboard_forget_memory_source only accepts conversation_id:exchange:source_ref. A retained new task experience is rejected by the ordinary owner erasure path.
blockers.requiredCorrection: Permit only a durably proven exact private work-outcome source through the existing document erasure flow; retain its projection/removal marker.
